title: UniAudio: An Audio Foundation Model Toward Universal Audio Generation
layout_note: The overview (left ~45%) is a bottom-to-top stack of levels; the Multi-Scale Transformer box is opened into a half-width detail panel on the right, tied to it by a dashed curved arrow.
grouping: Left: three dashed rounded frames stacked bottom to top ('Tokenization for Multiple Modalities' with Phoneme, MIDI, Text, Semantic Token, Audio; 'Task Formulation for Multiple Tasks' with TTS, VC, SE, TSE, ...; a frame holding Condition Sequences and Target Audio Sequence), then a wide Multi-Scale Transformer bar and a dashed-outline 'Predicted Audio Sequence' box. Right: one large dashed rounded frame holding the opened transformer, grouped into three frame columns.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with thin coloured outlines and pastel fills (green, pink-red, yellow, blue); no shadows or 3-D. Tokens are small square cells in groups of three labelled z_t^k; predicted cells and the per-frame vectors leaving the Global Transformer have dashed outlines; summation is a circled plus.
proposed_highlight: The Multi-Scale Transformer is expanded into a detail panel taking the whole right half; Global and Local Transformer blocks share one blue fill, the Global one drawn as a single wide bar spanning all frame columns.
lesson: Open the one novel module into a half-width panel tied by a dashed curved callout, and draw its two levels as one wide block spanning every frame column under a row of per-frame copies of the small block.
notes: venue = arXiv; the candidate list gives ICML 2024, not verified in this session (the arXiv first page reads 'Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2024'); year = arXiv preprint year. Method name UniAudio from the title and caption.

arrangement.units: left column: three dashed rounded frames stacked bottom to top under a solid Multi-Scale Transformer bar; right half: one large dashed rounded frame holding the opened transformer (three frame columns), linked by a dashed curved arrow from the bar
arrangement.inputs_as: named boxes (Phoneme, MIDI, Text, Semantic Token, Audio) in the overview; rows of token cells z_t^k at the bottom of the detail panel
arrangement.losses_at: none drawn; the predicted tokens are dashed-outline cells above each Local Transformer, and the overview ends in a dashed 'Predicted Audio Sequence' box
arrangement.shared: one Global Transformer bar spans all three frame columns; the Local Transformer is drawn as three identical copies, one per frame

taxonomy.task: universal audio generation (TTS, VC, SE, TSE, ...) as next-token prediction over discrete audio tokens

insights.structure: A narrow bottom-to-top overview stack on the left (modalities, tasks, condition/target sequences, transformer, prediction) and the transformer's internals as a wide dashed panel on the right.
insights.data: Tokens are drawn as labelled cells z_t^k in groups of three per frame, ⊕-merged into one cell per frame below the Global Transformer, and the predictions as dashed-outline cells including <e> end markers.
insights.emphasis: The novel multi-scale transformer gets half the width and the only detailed drawing; the left stack is a compact list of text boxes.
insights.flow: Everything reads upward on short vertical arrows: per-frame token groups into one Global bar, its per-frame outputs added to shifted tokens into each Local copy, predicted tokens on top.
insights.avoid: Colour changes meaning between panels: on the left green/red/yellow mark condition, target audio and task boxes, on the right the same hues mark which frame a token belongs to.

core.what: the transformer unrolled over three frame columns: each frame's three token cells ⊕-merged into one wide Global Transformer bar spanning all columns, and above it one Local Transformer copy per frame emitting that frame's next tokens

relations.form: three identical frame columns in the detail panel, each a token triple below the shared Global bar and a Local Transformer copy above it, outputs shifted one frame along
the Multi-Scale Transformer bar in the overview is opened into a large dashed frame on the right, tied by a dashed curved arrow
all modalities and tasks are stacked in dashed frames beneath one Multi-Scale Transformer bar, so every task feeds the same model
overview levels read bottom to top on small dashed arrows: tokenization, task formulation, condition/target sequences, transformer, predicted audio
circled-plus glyphs merge each frame's three tokens before the Global bar, and add each Global output to the shifted tokens entering a Local copy

channels.colour: two meanings: on the left, sequence role (green condition/text-like inputs, pink-red audio target, yellow tasks); on the right, which frame a token belongs to (green z1, yellow z2, red z3, purple <e>); blue = transformer module in both
channels.shape: rounded rectangles for modules and for named sequences alike; small square cells = tokens; circled plus = summation
channels.line: solid arrows = data flow in the detail; dashed outlines = predicted outputs and the intermediate per-frame vectors; dashed curved arrow = zoom callout
channels.frame: dashed rounded frame = one level of the overview, or the zoomed detail panel

quality.strengths: The global/local split is visible as geometry (one bar spanning all frames vs three per-frame copies); tokens are drawn as labelled cells between the blocks that consume and produce them; the novel transformer gets half the width; all arrows are short and vertical.
quality.weaknesses: Hues are reused with a different meaning in the two panels (yellow = task boxes on the left, frame-2 tokens on the right); the overview's task formulation is only a list of named boxes, not the sequences it builds; dashed outlines mean both 'predicted' and 'intermediate vector'.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
